items.corrections: Independent paper abstract supports phylogenomic reconstruction and early diversification; causal gene/pollinator/environment program and impact remain unsubstantiated.
Read review describes plasmodesmal communication but provides no primary demonstration of the full gating program or whole-plant seconds-scale assertion.
Review establishes engineering nitrogen-fixing cereals as a research goal; no inspected primary result establishes the claimed Nod-factor-independent pathway.
Mechanosensing synthesis proposes a layered framework and explicitly unresolved variable attribution; it supports the research challenge, not a complete demonstrated feedback system.
Read synthesis describes microtubule alignment associations and responsive wall coupling; it does not directly demonstrate universal force-to-expression causation across cell types.
Corrected primary paper URL shows a five-generation drought experiment and limited memory, supporting an unresolved mechanism question rather than reliable adaptive inheritance.
Primary rice-cross mapping provides a bounded rhizome network result; conserved switch across rice/wheat/maize, yield and global impacts remain unsupported.
Original Annual Reviews DOI/title unconfirmed; newly opened actual AM review summarizes mechanisms but does not substantiate a complete rule set or 30–50% gains.
Three-species comparative genomics supports duplication/recruitment mechanisms in Droseraceae; universal transfer and pesticide-free crops remain unsupported.
Original division DOI/title unconfirmed; actual opened review explicitly identifies unresolved spatial control. Perfect universal wall placement is not demonstrated.

notes: Confirmed corrections for two unrelated PMC sources; found third unrelated PMC source at s9.
Removed unverified Annual Reviews titles at s11/s13. Replacement sources retain distinct URL provenance.
Reviews do not establish primary achieved capabilities; classifications narrowed.
